\begin{highlights}
\item On TabReD the best of three systems on one 31B model is level with tuned LightGBM
\item Most of AutoDS-Tools' lead over Terminus-2 on TabReD comes from its instruction file
\item FEDOT.LLM, the only system that tunes, beats all 18 tuned methods on one TabReD task
\item Given a script, AutoDS-Tools' instructions leave \mlabWiped{} of \mlabRepeated{} tasks with no submission
\item Terminus-2 with the task text alone matched or beat two scientific author baselines
\end{highlights}
